a.title: • TableDirectionValues: Indicates whether the tables in the group should be displayed with the first column on the right, on the left, or based on the first character in the table that has a specific direction.

a.title: • TextDirectionValues: Indicates whether the text within cells should be displayed as left-to-right text (ltr), as right-to-left text (rtl), according to the content of the cell (auto) or in the direction inherited from the table direction annotation of the table.
